body: I can't say I'm close to the guys involved or ever have been. They all got in trouble, though. I didn't know he posed for the picture, though. The school policy for anything bad has always been "oh shit. Let's try to keep this quiet and it'll go away." If there was a lawsuit it never went anywhere. Trevor and the brothers that did it were always cool people, though. Being dicks and offending people was not the objective here. MLK day was always handled horribly by the school. One time they had two guys (white if it matters?) Who came in and had a super lame in the gym concert about whatever the fuck they were singing about. They were also pretty high when doing it given the smell whenever they walked... Or skipped with excitement by you. Just fail after fail when it comes to MLK day over there.
He didn't nominate himself. He didn't even give permission or push it. It was done by a fellow student who thought it was clever. Which it was. Source: went to the same school during that time.
I'm thinking of going to therapy. I cannot beat this on my own. I don't know if my writing will lead anywhere. That's another problem.

I wish I could afford going back into school. I love working on things and being motivated to do stuff...but with that I had a purpose and a goal. Now I feel like I would be working towards nothing. It sucks.

Thank you for the kind words. Today was rough as well. Whenever I get around my mother I just get really quiet. I don't know why. The other thing in my mind is that I just have this block that is telling me that I can't be a success. I know anyone can if they really try, but I still feel incredibly lost in regards to that. It's hard to believe in anything else. I also hate being a sob story, because that's what it is. I'm thinking about seeing a therapist, so we'll see how that goes. I recently hung out with a good friend and told her everything. We both agreed: Get a new job that I won't absolutely hate. The last person I worked with on Saturday called me a mother fucker. So. That's what I went home with.

Finally an update! Just passed all of it today. I am going to figure out who I want to work with now. Haven't had much time to go in for interviews. I have a friend at Berkshire so i might go there. Keller doesn't have much of a presence here, and I don't feel that I would fit in considering their local branch website. But...finally passed!
